mentions.name: Mint
mentions.description: A programming language approaching its 1.0 release in January. The feature set is considered complete, so work focuses on polishing, optimizing, and improving the documentation.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on the Mint programming language (https://mint-lang.com/) with a 1.0 release in January :). I'm happy with the current feature set, so I'm just polishing and optimizing where I can and giving the documentation a throughout look.
